config.scope: A fixed observational exclusion control for background covariance. It neither selects galaxies by gravity residuals nor admits a galaxy motion likelihood.
config.trigger: Released positive HI support overlaps at least one old background partition in 11/12 galaxies, including strong overlap in two galaxies that passed all old moment checks.
config.mask_rule: Intersect each original calibration/validation mask with the complement of the previously declared four-sigma-smoothing-plus-two-cell expanded HI support. Preserve all 16 original splits, guards, strides, thresholds and channel/spatial estimators. Do not rebalance or search for a favorable split.
config.support_gate: Require the original 150 calibration and 25 validation pixels and at least four validation pixels in each sky quadrant before fitting covariance. Retain insufficient-support cases as coverage failures, not failed gravity predictions.
config.nondetection_caveat: This exclusion uses a released moment product derived from the same observation. Undetected emission, continuum residuals and selection effects can remain. Passing is not proof of pure noise, Gaussianity, independent selection or inner-galaxy noise transfer.
independent_benchmarks: Excluded support cannot enter either mask
No added pixels, no broken guards and no split rebalancing
Noise values cannot affect mask construction

prior_exposure: Existing galaxies, support maps and original noise diagnostics were inspected in development. The new excluded-mask diagnostics were not.
